import pandas as pd

trips = tables['trips']

# Analyze by DOY to find peaks/troughs
doy_stats = trips.groupby('fished_date_doy').agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum',
    'boat': 'count'
}).reset_index()

# Calculate average yt per angler by DOY
doy_stats['yt_per_angler'] = doy_stats['yt'] / doy_stats['anglers']
doy_stats = doy_stats.sort_values('fished_date_doy')

# Focus on key periods: April (90-100), May-Sept (130-270), Oct (280-310)
print("=== APRIL PEAK (DOY 90-100) ===")
april = doy_stats[(doy_stats['fished_date_doy'] >= 90) & (doy_stats['fished_date_doy'] <= 100)]
if len(april) > 0:
    print(april[['fished_date_doy', 'yt', 'anglers', 'boat', 'yt_per_angler']])
    print(f"\nAverage: {april['yt_per_angler'].mean():.2f} yt/angler")
else:
    print("No data")

print("\n=== DEAD ZONE (DOY 180-270) ===")
dead = doy_stats[(doy_stats['fished_date_doy'] >= 180) & (doy_stats['fished_date_doy'] <= 270)]
if len(dead) > 0:
    print(f"Sample: {dead.head(10)}")
    print(f"Average: {dead['yt_per_angler'].mean():.2f} yt/angler")
else:
    print("No data")

print("\n=== OCTOBER PEAK (DOY 285-305) ===")
october = doy_stats[(doy_stats['fished_date_doy'] >= 285) & (doy_stats['fished_date_doy'] <= 305)]
if len(october) > 0:

else:

    'yt': 'sum',

    'boat': 'count'
}).reset_index()

SELECT fish_date_doy, fish_date_season, COUNT(*) as num_trips
FROM schedule
WHERE fish_date_t > 450 AND fish_date_t < 465
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, fish_date_season
ORDER BY fish_date_doy
LIMIT 20

SELECT fished_date_doy, fish_date_season, COUNT(*) as num_trips, SUM(yt) as total_yt, ROUND(SUM(yt)::float/SUM(anglers), 2) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_t > 400 AND fish_date_t < 460
GROUP BY fished_date_doy, fish_date_season
ORDER BY fished_date_doy
